{{Quote|Because of my failure, my people lost their honor and accepted ''peez''&ndash;subjection to the infidels. They have been allowed to live like tame ''tso'asu'' on the weapon-world, with my betrothed among them.|An entry in Darth Vua's personal holocron|<ref name="tegtw">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-12-tales-of-the-new-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 12: Tales of the New Republic}}</ref>}}
At some point after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the former [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Slayers|Slayer]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Vua]] created a '''personal holocron'''. Within the [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]], Vua recorded his thoughts on his role in the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|final defeat]] of the Yuuzhan Vong and his subsequent capture by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] faction known as the [[One Sith]].
